details: update_storm: updateAnnotations() calls selectAll('*').remove() and rebuilds all annotation DOM nodes on every simulation tick (ticked→updateAnnotations), causing full DOM mutation at 60fps with no RAF coalescing or dirty flag; handoff_race: goToStage() starts new enter/update/exit transitions without calling .interrupt() on in-flight selections, so rapid IntersectionObserver triggers during 600ms enter transitions cause mid-flight snap on nodes.
